_doc.about: Refresh rates of the session-status skill. Deployed to ~/.agent-behaviors/session-status.json, which is the copy to edit. Every reader re-reads it while running, so a valid change applies without restarting anything. A value that is missing, not a number or out of range falls back to its default; a file that is not valid JSON (e.g. half-saved) is ignored and the previous settings are kept. Keys starting with _ are documentation.
_doc.statusSessionSeconds: How often the <model>.status background session runs its cycle when no activity message wakes it (60-3600).
_doc.viewerUsageSeconds: How often the viewers re-measure token usage with usage.py (10-3600).
_doc.viewerBoardSeconds: How often the viewers re-read the board, on top of reacting to file changes at once (1-300).
_doc.doneVisibleHours: How long a session whose state is done stays in reports and viewers, counted from when it reached done (0-720; 0 hides done sessions at once).
